bearings.cap: Relative bearings, from your own bow.

deck-fittings.cap: Along the side deck. Flat transom aft, stem and anchor roller forward.

engine-cooling.cap: Raw water in, heat out with the exhaust. The two circuits never mix.

flares.cap: Three of these mean distress. The white one does not.

hull-plan.cap: Seen from above, bow at the top — as if you were facing forward.

hull-profile.cap: In profile, afloat at her designed waterline.

latlong.cap: A chart's two scales. Only one of them measures distance.

mooring-lines.cap: Alongside, seen from above. Bow to the right.

motions.cap: The three ways a hull turns about herself.

prop-walk.cap: A right-handed propeller, seen from above.

rigging.cap: Standing rigging holds the mast up. Running rigging moves.

sail-parts.cap: The mainsail, her bow to the right like every other drawing here.

standing-turn.cap: Turning her in her own length, seen from above.

windward-lee.cap: Seen from astern. She heels away from the wind.
